item.description:
Thimble 0.3.1 makes the Dashboard easier to read.
- On the Mac, every other project is shaded and a line sits under the column names, so a project's numbers are easy to follow across. - Claude's 5-hour and weekly limits now stretch with the window, in full screen too. - On Android, each project shows its numbers in a small grid, each under its own name, with a line between projects. The week's Claude cost sits next to the project's name.
